Quick back-of-envelope (assumptions called out):
Assumptions:
- Model: 13B quantized (13B-qt) — token compute ~0.008s/token on optimized A100 kernels (est) when KV misses; KV hits reduce effective tokens by ~25% on average
- Average tokens/request (prompt + response) = 60 + 120 = 180 tokens
- Sustained baseline + 40% growth -> 168 req/s (~120 * 1.4) -> tokens/s = 168 * 180 = 30,240 tok/s
- Effective tokens/s after KV benefit (~40% reuse) = 30,240 * 0.75 = 22,680 tok/s
- Per-GPU throughput (A100-80GB, quantized 13B tuned): ~5,000 effective tok/s (conservative)

Sizing math:
- Sustained GPUs required = ceil(22,680 / 5,000) = 5 GPUs (reserved)
- Bursts: 1,800 req/s -> tokens/s = 1,800 * 180 = 324,000 tok/s -> effective = 243,000 tok/s after KV
- GPUs needed during burst = ceil(243,000 / 5,000) = 49 GPUs

Recommendation:
- Reserved commit: 5 x A100-80GB (predictable baseline; supports p99 ~120-150ms with warm cache and session affinity)
- Burst/autoscale plan: allow autoscale up to ~50 GPUs with burst credits or transient capacity; configure fast scale-up policy and keep a small warm buffer (2 additional GPUs) to reduce cold-start tail
- Alternate SKU mix: if you want to reduce reserved cost, mix 2xA100 reserved + autoscale to more for bursts; or consider 8-bit accelerated SKUs (if model validation allows) to increase per-GPU throughput to ~7k tok/s and reduce burst pool size to ~35 GPUs.

Operational notes / red flags:
- Streaming token-by-token increases p99 sensitivity: we should ensure low-latency network path and enable token batch-size=1 optimized kernels for streaming endpoints.
- Long contexts (4% >2k tokens) add memory pressure; ensure model VM can store >2k KV cache entries without eviction for hot sessions.
- Since traffic is multi-tenant, session affinity is recommended to keep KV hit rates high and reduce fleet needs.

Next steps:
- Ben to draft cost + commit options (5 reserved GPUs baseline; 3 reserved variant + higher autoscale runway).
- Marissa to schedule 30m call with Samira to walk through trade-offs and confirm burst window SLAs.

Karthik
